drafts.title: Turn Nine
drafts.pitch: On Halloween something whispers from the middle of the context: the user's birthday, mentioned once on turn nine, which nobody ever looked at. Cursor guesses "Halloween?" Tilde: "Happy birthday."
drafts.reason: Lost-in-the-middle is a sharp in-world premise and the birthday reveal lands, but panel 4 stacks a question, a guess and the punchline, so the payoff is a beat slow.

drafts.title: Top Line
drafts.pitch: Cursor charts its progress as a flat line of tens; Null adds the replies line along the bottom, and Tilde asks who scored the top one. From Naomi's comment on 023.
drafts.reason: Tilde's 'who scored the top one' is a good line, but the strip re-runs Fourteen Tens without a new twist.
